compute_depth_indices: compute cumulative depth indices from a list of sparse coordinate tensors for keyframe optimization
calculate_optimization_dimensions: calculate parameter block dimensions and slice ranges for keyframe poses, affine params, scales, and depths
build_forward_keyframe_edges: build forward consecutive keyframe edge indices for pose, scale, and depth optimization variables
compute_gradient_and_hessian: compute gradient vectors and diagonal or off-diagonal Hessian blocks from Jacobian and residual tensors
solve_and_update_optimization: solve the linear system via Cholesky decomposition and update poses, affine params, scales, and depth variables
